init_hook: rustup default stable 2>/dev/null || rustup install stable
command -v cargo-insta >/dev/null || (echo '📦 Installing cargo-insta...' && cargo install cargo-insta)
command -v kcl >/dev/null || (echo '📦 Installing KCL CLI...' && curl -fsSL https://kcl-lang.io/script/install-cli.sh | bash)

scripts.build-kcl: mkdir -p output && cd kcl && kcl run designs/blinky.k -o ../output/blinky.json --format json
scripts.all: devbox run build-kcl && devbox run build-rust && devbox run convert
scripts.all-pcb: devbox run build-kcl && devbox run build-rust && devbox run pcb
